# `aitbc dashboard customer`

Show the customer dashboard with jobs, payments, and wallet balances.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dashboard customer [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `20` | no | Number of recent jobs to show |
| `--wallet-limit` | integer | `10` | no | Number of wallet balances to show |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dashboard customer
```
